Interface LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareEventBuilder

All Superinterfaces:
LoggingEventBuilder
Enclosing class:
LoggerDecoratorService
public static interface LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareEventBuilder extends LoggingEventBuilder
Because wrapping can change the depth of the logger in the callstack this interface allows implementations to change the depth of the event builder. It also exposes read access to whatever has been set on the builder so far - message, cause, arguments, key values - none of which plain LoggingEventBuilder exposes, so a decorator that needs to inspect (not just add to) an event has a way to do so.
